name: Saber-Toothed Tiger

source.note: Numbers follow the 2014 Monster Manual block (the one Curse of Strahd uses); the 2024 changes are not entered yet. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Its damage bonus is +5 as printed although Strength 18 gives +4. Pounce is text only (the engine doesn't track a straight-line charge).

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.summary: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
traits.text: The tiger has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use its sense of smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.summary: After a 20 ft straight run, a Claw hit forces a DC 14 Str save or Prone, then a Bite as a Bonus Action.
traits.text: If the tiger moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw or has the Prone condition. Against a Prone target, the tiger can make one Bite attack as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: Drives its long fangs into a target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: Rakes a target with heavy claws.

summary: A huge striped cat with dagger fangs: charges in, knocks prey down with its claws and bites the fallen.
